description: Controlled single-seed 15000-round Task 2 target-aggregation logic ablation. Relative to reward v3.3, it changes only states with safely available coin and bomb objectives: each objective contributes its independently signed class strength and the two contributions are averaged. Joint directions receive 0.5 * lambda * (s_coin + s_bomb), coin-only directions receive 0.5 * lambda * (s_coin - s_bomb), bomb-only directions receive 0.5 * lambda * (s_bomb - s_coin), and directions following neither receive -0.5 * lambda * (s_coin + s_bomb). The target scale remains 0.020. Single-objective target rewards, class strengths, all outcome and bomb-site rewards, movement costs, the self-kill penalty, urgency penalties, feature version, action space, learning rate, exploration schedule, discount factor, seeds, and evaluation protocol remain unchanged.
